transactioncolumncustomfield.description: v2.3 line-level: pricing-timing pattern for this scrap line (Known at PO / Determined on Arrival / Determined After Processing). Each line is its own deal. Drives whether settlement auto-creates at receipt or waits for the on-demand button.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Per-line pricing pattern. Known at PO / Determined on Arrival = price known by receipt, settlement auto-creates. Determined After Processing = recovery-priced, settlement is created on demand once outputs are known. If left blank, the header Pricing Timing (custbody_sust_pricing_timing) is used as the fallback.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: Pricing Timing
